openapi_summary: REST endpoints are the canonical business interface; MCP tools call the same service layer and inherit identical authorization and limits.

identity.production: OIDC access token validated by API gateway/service
identity.demo: X-Demo-Role and X-Customer-ID for general APIs; X-Demo-User-ID is registry-resolved for proposal approval

targets_not_enforced.rate_limit: 429 quota/rate limiting is a production target, not implemented locally
targets_not_enforced.dependency_unavailable: 503 dependency-health mapping is a production target, not implemented locally

endpoints.purpose: Bounded topology neighborhood with as-of snapshot and provenance
Time-window KPI values with formula version, status and completeness
Acknowledge an investigation as RECEIVED, then analyze evidence asynchronously
Read tenant-scoped investigation state, findings, and transition history
Process an idempotent late KPI event and recalculate investigation findings
Create approval-gated proposal; never executes network action
List proposals for the authenticated customer only
Persist one authorized human approval; executed remains false
Persist one authorized human rejection; executed remains false

error_model.404: entity absent or outside tenant scope
error_model.409: proposal already has a final decision or event ID conflicts with prior payload
